_note: The Event node's scenes and the Bloodied Oath (phase 5c step 8c; docs/plans/events.md, rebuild-phase5c-combos.md section 16.7, Decision 43). Each scene's choices carry their results: named run actions (RunFlow, one job each; EventDef.RESULTS): item (a random item of `kinds` at `rank`, `count` of them), wound (a hero you choose), clear_wounds, relic (a random relic of `tier`, or by the shops' odds), dear_shop (the next shop's prices times `bp`), pay and gain (shards), deed (a hero you choose gains `share_bp` of its vowed path's threshold, never past it), next_fight (one of next_fight_mods on a hero you choose, or the team, for the next day fight), seal (tomorrow's fight is a win at half pay with its pick; not when tomorrow is an elite or the boss), rank_up_random and rank_up_chosen (an item a rank up), weaken (a random hero's max HP times `bp` for the rest of the act), hunt (a Hunt's pack now), mirror (a hero you choose, not transformed, switches its vow to a path you choose, the new path gaining half its share of the old one's progress). Leaving the node without a choice is walking away, always free. An Event node is a Bloodied Oath oath_pct in 100: 2 oaths, each on a random hero, for that hero's next oath_fights day fights. All numbers are first guesses.

scenes.name: The Kneeling Knight
scenes.text: A hero of another band, dead where they knelt, sword still across their knees.

choices.label: Take his blade
choices.text: A random charm at rank II; a hero you choose takes a wound.

choices.label: Bury him
choices.text: Every wound on the team is cleared.

scenes.name: The Rift Merchant
scenes.text: A stall with no keeper. The goods hum. Something is keeping count.

choices.label: Take a relic
choices.text: A random epic relic; the next shop's wares and relic cost 50% more.

choices.label: Leave coin
choices.text: Pay 10 shards for a random rare relic.

scenes.name: Whispering Stones
scenes.text: A ring of stones that speak of what a hero might become, if they would only listen.

choices.label: Listen
choices.text: A hero you choose gains a third of its path's deed; it has no signature in its next fight.

scenes.name: A Bleeding Tear
scenes.text: A wound in the air, weeping light. Something on the other side is reaching too.

choices.label: Reach in
choices.text: A random relic of a random tier.

choices.label: Seal it
choices.text: Tomorrow's fight is won without fighting: half its pay, and its pick. Not before an elite or the boss.

scenes.name: The Old Well
scenes.text: Black water, very still. It remembers every coin.

choices.label: Drink
choices.text: A random item you own goes a rank up; a random hero loses 10% max HP for the rest of the act.

choices.label: Throw in a coin
choices.text: Pay 5 shards: an item you choose goes a rank up.

scenes.name: Carrion Birds
scenes.text: They circle something that isn't quite dead. They'd circle you too.

choices.label: Drive them off
choices.text: Fight a small pack now for shards; losing it isn't a loss.

scenes.name: The Mirror Pool
scenes.text: The water shows a hero as they might have been, sworn to another way.

choices.label: Look in
choices.text: A hero you choose, not yet transformed, takes another of its paths, keeping half its progress.

scenes.name: Ashes of a Band
scenes.text: A camp burned out long ago. Their packs lie where they dropped them.

choices.label: Say their names
choices.text: Every wound on the team is cleared, and every hero has +5% max HP in the next fight.

oaths.name: Oath of Silence
oaths.reward: Its deeds count double, and +20% ATK and MGK.

oaths.name: Oath of the Vanguard
oaths.burden: It stands on the front row, and its tactic is set aside.
oaths.reward: Its deeds count double, and +20 DEF.
